# Maintainex - Professional Home Services
> Maintainex connects you with verified professionals for cleaning, repairs, assembly, and more across Sri Lanka and Canada.

## About
Maintainex is a platform that offers professional home and commercial services including cleaning, plumbing, electrical work, painting, assembly, mounting, moving, outdoor maintenance, and repairs. We operate in Sri Lanka (maintainex.lk) and Canada (ca.maintainex.lk).

## Service Categories
- Cleaning: https://maintainex.lk/services/cleaning (residential, deep, office, carpet, sofa)
